I.There are several cases where shareholders are holding shares in multiple folios, the same have been clubbed based on common PAN in this shareholding pattern;
II.Pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement sanctioned by the Honble National Company Law Tribunal on 12th August 2022, shareholders of Piramal Enterprises Limited (PEL) (PEL was merged into Piramal Finance Limited with effect from September 16, 2025) were allotted shares in the Company. In terms of Regulation 40 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, shares are to be issued and allotted in dematerialized form only. In view of this, equity shares which were allotted to those shareholders who hold shares of PEL in physical form, have been credited into an Escrow Account opened by the Company for this purpose. On receipt of the demat account details and necessary documentation from the said allottee(s), the Company credits the Equity Shares to the beneficiary demat account(s) after due validation.
III. Shareholding of Mr. Ajay G Piramal as mentioned in the shareholding pattern includes shares held in his personal capacity and shares as held by Gopikishan Piramal HUF (Mr. Ajay G Piramal - karta of HUF) and excludes 620 shares held by Mr. Ajay G. Piramal in his capacity as an executor of the will of Late Dr. K. S. Basu.
IV. Piramal Pharma Limited - Employee Stock Option and Incentive Plan - 2022 is being implemented through a Trust.
V. Shrikrishna Services Private Limited has become a wholly owned subsidiary of PDL Realty Private Limited and a part of promoter group with effect from 22nd April, 2026.
VI. AnsaPack (FC) Private Limited has become a subsidiary of Piramal Retail Private Limited and a part of promoter group with effect from 30th June, 2026.
VII. Consequent to Ansapack (FC) Private Limited becoming a subsidiary of Piramal Retail Private Limited, its subsidiary Rich Printer Private Limited became part of promoter group with effect from 30th June, 2026.
VIII. Consequent to Ansapack (FC) Private Limited becoming a subsidiary of Piramal Retail Private Limited, its subsidiary Webteck Printpack Private Limited became part of promoter group with effect from 30th June, 2026
